```yaml
name: Update compat-table dependency

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Every Monday at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: update-compat-table
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js and pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 8
          run_install: false

      - name: Install pnpm dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Fetch latest compat-table SHA
        run: |
          LATEST_SHA=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/compat-table/compat-table.git HEAD | cut -f1)
          echo "LATEST_SHA=$LATEST_SHA" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Read current compat-table SHA
        run: |
          CURRENT_SHA=$(jq -r '.dependencies."compat-table" // .devDependencies."compat-table"' tasks/compat_data/package.json)
          echo "CURRENT_SHA=$CURRENT_SHA" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Skip if no update needed
        if: ${{ env.LATEST_SHA == env.CURRENT_SHA }}
        run: echo "compat-table is already up to date. No action required."

      - name: Update package.json with new SHA
        if: ${{ env.LATEST_SHA != env.CURRENT_SHA }}
        run: |
          jq --arg sha "$LATEST_SHA" '
            .dependencies."compat-table" = $sha
            | .devDependencies."compat-table" = $sha
          ' tasks/compat_data/package.json > tmp && mv tmp tasks/compat_data/package.json

      - name: Rebuild compatibility data
        if: ${{ env.LATEST_SHA != env.CURRENT_SHA }}
        run: |
          pnpm run init
          pnpm run build

      - name: Commit changes
        if: ${{ env.LATEST_SHA != env.CURRENT_SHA }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add tasks/compat_data/package.json
          git commit -m "chore: update compat-table to $LATEST_SHA" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/update-compat-table-${{ env.LATEST_SHA }} --force

      - name: Create pull request
        if: ${{ env.LATEST_SHA != env.CURRENT_SHA }}
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update compat-table to ${{ env.LATEST_SHA }}"
          title: "chore: update compat-table to latest commit"
          body: |
            Updated compat-table from `${{ env.CURRENT_SHA }}` to `${{ env.LATEST_SHA }}`.
            This ensures the project uses the most recent compatibility data.
          assignees: Boshen
          branch: update-compat-table-${{ env.LATEST_SHA }}
          base: main
```
